Import.AConfirmOfAClosedImportWritesNoth.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !isConfirm(command) || isOpen(before) || after.status === before.status

Import.TheRestNameEveryChangeToo.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !endsOrReopens(command) ||
        isUnstaged(before) ||
        isRemoved(before) ||
        isUnstaged(after) ||
        command.seen === before.changes

Import.EveryChangeHasItsOwnNumber.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        isUnstaged(before) ||
        isRemoved(before) ||
        isUnstaged(after) ||
        isRemoved(after) ||
        after.changes === before.changes + (isSuggestion(command) ? 0 : 1)

Import.OnlyAnImportWithAConfirmStandingI.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !isTakeBack(command) || isUnstaged(before) || isRemoved(before) || isUnstaged(after) || before.standing >= 1

Import.ATakeBackIsOfEverythingInForce.source:
({ before, after, command, events }) =>
        !isTakeBack(command) ||
        isUnstaged(before) ||
        isRemoved(before) ||
        isUnstaged(after) ||
        isRemoved(after) ||
        (after.standing === 0 &&
          after.replaced === 0 &&
          after.inForce === command.kept &&
          A.every(events, (e) => !isTakenBackEvent(e) || e.removed + e.kept === before.inForce))

Import.AndOfEverythingReplaced.source:
({ before, command, events }) =>
        !isTakeBack(command) ||
        isUnstaged(before) ||
        isRemoved(before) ||
        A.every(events, (e) => !isTakenBackEvent(e) || e.restored + e.keptReplaced === before.replaced)

Import.ASuggestionWritesNothing.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !isSuggestion(command) ||
        !isOpen(before) ||
        (isOpen(after) && after.matching === before.matching && after.changes === before.changes)

Import.OnlyAnOpenImportIsReviewed.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        isOpen(before) ||
        isUnstaged(before) ||
        isRemoved(before) ||
        isRemoved(after) ||
        isUnstaged(after) ||
        after.matching === before.matching

Import.AnImportIsOpenedAgainOnlyByReopen.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !isOpen(after) ||
        isOpen(before) ||
        isUnstaged(before) ||
        (isReopen(command) && (isImported(before) || isTakenBack(before)))

Import.AnImportNeverChangesOrganization.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        isUnstaged(before) || isUnstaged(after) || before.organizationId === after.organizationId

Row.ARowNeverChangesImportOrOrganization.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        isUntouched(before) ||
        isUntouched(after) ||
        (before.organizationId === after.organizationId && before.importId === after.importId)

Group.AGroupNeverChangesImportOrOrganiza.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        isUntouchedGroup(before) ||
        isUntouchedGroup(after) ||
        (before.organizationId === after.organizationId && before.importId === after.importId)

DecideRow.ADecisionIsReplacedOnlyByAnAct.source:
({ before, command }) =>
        sameAsItsOwn({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        (isDecided(before.row) ? command.saw === before.row.change : command.saw === 0)

DecideRow.AnActIsMadeOnTheMatchingNow.source:
({ before, command }) =>
        sameAsItsOwn({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        (isOpen(before.life) && command.madeOn === before.life.matching)

DecideRow.AnActThatChangesNothingLeavesT.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !isOpen(before.life) ||
        !isOpen(after.life) ||
        after.life.changes === before.life.changes

({ before, after, command }) =>
        !changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !isDecided(before.row) ||
        !isDecided(after.row) ||
        after.row.change === before.row.change

DecideRow.AnyOtherActIsRecorded.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) || isDecided(after.row)

DecideRow.WithItsText.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !isDecided(after.row) ||
        after.row.flags === command.flags

DecideRow.OnItsMatching.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !isDecided(after.row) ||
        after.row.madeOn === command.madeOn

DecideRow.UnderItsStep.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !isDecided(after.row) ||
        after.row.step === command.step

DecideRow.AndGetsTheNextNumber.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !isOpen(before.life) ||
        !isOpen(after.life) ||
        after.life.changes === before.life.changes + 1

DecideRow.OnTheRowToo.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !isOpen(after.life) ||
        !isDecided(after.row) ||
        after.row.change === after.life.changes

DecideRow.AnActKeepsWhichDecisionItRepla.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !isDecided(before.row) ||
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !isDecided(after.row) ||
        after.row.under.change === before.row.change

DecideRow.AndWhose.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !isDecided(before.row) ||
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !isDecided(after.row) ||
        after.row.under.by === before.row.by

DecideRow.AndItsText.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !isDecided(before.row) ||
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !isDecided(after.row) ||
        after.row.under.flags === before.row.flags

DecideRow.AndItsMatching.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !isDecided(before.row) ||
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !isDecided(after.row) ||
        after.row.under.madeOn === before.row.madeOn

DecideRow.AndWhatWasBelowStaysBelow.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !isDecided(before.row) ||
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !isDecided(after.row) ||
        after.row.below ===
          (before.row.under.change === 0
            ? ""
            : before.row.below.length > MOST_BELOW
              ? CUT
              : seal({ level: before.row.under, below: before.row.below }))

UndoRowStep.WhatLiesUnderIsWhatWasRecord.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        !isDecided(before.row) ||
        before.row.under.change === 0 ||
        !isDecided(after.row) ||
        (before.row.below === ""
          ? after.row.under.change === 0
          : before.row.below === CUT
            ? after.row.under.change === -1
            : seal({ level: after.row.under, below: after.row.below }) === before.row.below)

UndoRowStep.AnUndoIsNumbered.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        isOpen(before.life) && isOpen(after.life) && after.life.changes === before.life.changes + 1

UndoGroup.AGroupsUndoIsOneChange.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        isOpen(before.life) && isOpen(after.life) && after.life.changes === before.life.changes + 1

Catalog.NoTwoRowsHoldTheSameChange.source:
(all) =>
        A.every(all.Row, (a) =>
          A.every(
            all.Row,
            (b) =>
              a.id === b.id ||
              !isDecided(a.state) ||
              !isDecided(b.state) ||
              a.state.importId !== b.state.importId ||
              a.state.change !== b.state.change
          )
        )

Catalog.NoRowAndGroupHoldTheSameChange.source:
(all) =>
        A.every(all.Row, (row) =>
          A.every(
            all.Group,
            (group) =>
              !isDecided(row.state) ||
              !isDecidedGroup(group.state) ||
              row.state.importId !== group.state.importId ||
              (row.state.change !== group.state.change && row.state.change !== group.state.undoneAt)
          )
        )

Catalog.NoTwoGroupsHoldTheSameChange.source:
(all) =>
        A.every(all.Group, (a) =>
          A.every(
            all.Group,
            (b) =>
              a.id === b.id ||
              !isDecidedGroup(a.state) ||
              !isDecidedGroup(b.state) ||
              a.state.importId !== b.state.importId ||
              a.state.change !== b.state.change
          )
        )

Catalog.AGroupsChangeIsOneItsImportGave.source:
(all) =>
        A.every(all.Group, (group) =>
          A.every(
            all.Import,
            (life) =>
              !isDecidedGroup(group.state) ||
              group.state.importId !== life.id ||
              isRemoved(life.state) ||
              (!isUnstaged(life.state) && group.state.change >= 1 && group.state.undoneAt <= life.state.changes)
          )
        )

Catalog.TheLastGroupInForceIsInForce.source:
(all) =>
        A.every(all.Group, (group) =>
          A.every(
            all.Import,
            (life) =>
              !isDecidedGroup(group.state) ||
              group.state.importId !== life.id ||
              isRemoved(life.state) ||
              isUnstaged(life.state) ||
              group.state.change !== life.state.topGroup ||
              group.state.undoneAt === 0
          )
        )

Catalog.NoGroupActIsLaterThanTheImportsL.source:
(all) =>
        A.every(all.Group, (group) =>
          A.every(
            all.Import,
            (life) =>
              !isDecidedGroup(group.state) ||
              group.state.importId !== life.id ||
              isRemoved(life.state) ||
              isUnstaged(life.state) ||
              (group.state.change <= life.state.lastGroup && group.state.undoneAt <= life.state.lastGroup)
          )
        )

Catalog.ARowBelongsToItsImportsOrganizat.source:
({ life, row }) =>
          isUntouched(row.state) ||
          row.state.importId !== life.id ||
          (!isUnstaged(life.state) && row.state.organizationId === life.state.organizationId)

Catalog.AGroupBelongsToItsImportsOrganiz.source:
({ life, group }) =>
          isUntouchedGroup(group.state) ||
          group.state.importId !== life.id ||
          (!isUnstaged(life.state) && group.state.organizationId === life.state.organizationId)
